subject.title: Bug: preflight (budget-triggered) compaction hard-capped at ~60s, ignores compaction.timeoutSeconds

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95590 be the canonical fix for this issue's preflight compaction cancellation contract, with any preflight-disable config gate handled separately?
rationale: Current main still has the bug, but the remaining blocker is choosing the cancellation contract and proof bar rather than identifying a new code path.

options.title: Use the filtered-signal PR
options.body: Accept lifecycle `TimeoutError` filtering for required preflight compaction while preserving explicit and non-timeout cancellation, then land the open candidate PR after final merge checks.

options.title: Require reporter-backend proof first
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted run on the reported slow vLLM/Qwen setup proves the improvement outside the production-path seam test.

options.title: Bundle a config gate decision
options.body: Pause the cancellation fix until maintainers also decide whether to add `compaction.preflight.enabled` as an operator escape hatch.

recommendation.title: Use the filtered-signal PR
recommendation.body: Accept lifecycle `TimeoutError` filtering for required preflight compaction while preserving explicit and non-timeout cancellation, then land the open candidate PR after final merge checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-history trail points most strongly to Jared's preflight compaction work as the central affected path.
